name: Investor Residence Visa

qualifying_event.description: For foreign nationals investing at least 100x Ecuador's Salario Básico Unificado (SBU) in a qualifying vehicle: a term deposit of at least 730 days with a recognized lending institution, real estate registered in the cantonal property registry, shares/participations in an Ecuadorian company, or an active public investment/delegated-management contract with the state.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of the qualifying investment (deposit certificate, property deed, company share registration, or state contract) meeting the minimum threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: A term deposit certificate/policy of at least 730 days, for at least 100x SBU -- USD 48,200 at the 2026 SBU of USD 482 -- issued by a recognized lending institution.
Real estate ownership, registered by deed in the cantonal property registry, meeting the same 100x SBU (USD 48,200) minimum threshold.
Shares or participations in an Ecuadorian company, registered with the Superintendence of Companies, meeting the 100x SBU (USD 48,200) minimum threshold.

evidence_required.document: Investment proof matching the chosen category (deposit certificate, deed, share registration, or state contract)

outcome.duration_length: 2 years; permits unlimited time outside Ecuador and multiple re-entries during validity

sources.title: gob.ec (MREMH official portal) -- Investor residence visa: 100x SBU minimum across term-deposit (730+ days), real estate, company-shares, or state-contract categories, 2-year duration with unlimited absence allowance
NMS Abogados -- Ecuador sets the 2026 Salario Básico Unificado (SBU) at USD 482/month, giving a 100x SBU threshold of USD 48,200

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ecuador). Same SBU-conversion caveat as ec_rentista_visa.json and ec_digital_nomad_visa.json: the 100x multiplier is tier-1, the 2026 dollar figure (USD 48,200) is tier-3-derived. The USD 48,200 figure is independently corroborated by multiple immigration-consultancy sources reviewed during research, giving reasonable confidence despite the tier-3 sourcing. work_rights modeled 'restricted' -- this category authorizes the investment activity itself, not general employment.
